evidenceLineItems.reason: Included in the defence package as context, not as decisive proof.

evidenceLineItems.label: order_confirmation
evidenceLineItems.reason: Confirms order details, but does not prove the customer authorized the transaction.

internalSignals.label: Billing and shipping addresses on the order agree
internalSignals.reason: The billing and shipping addresses you hold for this order have the same city and country. This is an internal note about your own order record, not evidence: it is not a check by the cardholder's bank, so it is never scored and never included in the dispute response. Address verification comes from the issuer's AVS result on the payment row.

caseTypeInfo.issuerClaim: Customer claims the item was not received

conclusion.text: The carrier's own record shows delivery of a shipment containing every item ordered, and the dispute was opened seventeen days after that delivery. The non-receipt claim is not supported by the record.

summary: The customer says the order was not received. The carrier recorded delivery on 16 October 2026, and the dispute was opened seventeen days after that delivery. Both purchased items, each in the quantity ordered, travelled in a single tracked shipment. The carrier's own record, not a merchant document, confirms delivery. The merchant requests that Klarna close this dispute in the merchant's favour.

executiveSummary.text: The customer says the order was not received. The carrier recorded delivery on 16 October 2026, and the dispute was opened seventeen days after that delivery. Both purchased items, each in the quantity ordered, travelled in a single tracked shipment. The carrier's own record, not a merchant document, confirms delivery. The merchant requests that Klarna close this dispute in the merchant's favour.

fulfillmentArgument.text:
The carrier's own tracking record, linked below, shows the shipment as delivered on 16 October 2026; this is not a merchant document. Both items, each in the quantity ordered, were in that one shipment, and no second shipment exists, so every part of the order falls within that delivery record.

Carrier tracking record: https://www.dhl.com/us-en/home/tracking.html?submit=1&trackingid=TRK000001&tracking-id=TRK000001
